en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz who said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to Zurara and Muhammad Bin Muslim: ‘
The milk, and the colostrums, and the eggs, and the hair, and the wool, and the horns, and the teeth, and the hooves, and everything separated from the sheep and the animals, so it is clean,
and if it is taken from it after it has died, so wash it and Pray in it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim has stated this Hadith.
‘The milk, that kind of milk which is drawn first, eggs, hairs, wool, horns, teeth, hooves and everything separated from sheep and the stumper is clean
but if you take such things after the animal dies then wash it and perform Salat (prayer) with it.’”
